name: David
bio: David has been a follower of Christ and a member of the Christadelphians since he was 17 years old. When he was in his twenties, he lived in Central America for five years as a missionary and member of Christadelphian congregations in Costa Rica and El Salvador, during which time, he learned Spanish and gave many Bible classes and talks. While living in El Salvador, he met and married his wife. They moved to the United States in 1988 with their small family. Dave is still involved with the missionary work in Central America and Mexico, and makes yearly visits to Costa Rica and Mexico to support the congregations in those countries. He is also an active member of the Verdugo Hills Christadelphian Ecclesia in Tujunga, the congregation he has been a member of since he was baptized in 1979.

name: Jason
bio: Jason is a follower of Christ and a member of the Christadelphians. He is a teacher and the award-winning author of 12 books. His work has been featured in The Huffington Post as well as the BBC, and he has served as the historical advisor for a Holocaust documentary.

name: Allen
bio: Allen has been studying the Bible for almost three decades and has an academic             background in history and religious studies. He has extensive experience delivering lectures on various Bible subjects across the US and internationally.

name: Jason
bio: Jason is a projects manager and designer. He is an active Christadelphian in Thousand Oaks who teaches and volunteers at the Christadelphian Heritage Co-op.

name: Christian
bio: Christian is a bible student and teacher from the UK, who has lived and worked in Southern California for 30 years with his wife and family. He is always willing to share his passion for God’s word and has taught classes locally and internationally. His favorite topic is the grace of God at work in the lives of men and women.

name: James
bio: James grew up in Canada, but moved to Silicon Valley to work as a computer engineer. He has been a Christadelphian for 21 years, and tries to focus especially on the practical aspects of following Jesus in our modern world. He enjoys studying Romans, computers, and Japanese.
